title: Add authenticated repository discovery and selection
description: Let an authenticated user find repositories available under the current authorization and open one as the active workspace context.
acceptanceCriteria: Repository results come from the authorized account and support bounded search/pagination.
Selecting a repository preserves owner/name/default branch and resolves a concrete revision before repository data is shown.
Loading, empty, inaccessible, rate-limited, and retry states are handled without exposing credentials.
The active selection is consistent across the dashboard, 2D tree, inspector, and 3D world.

steps.description: Trace the existing repository chooser and API
steps.details: Preserve current component and data conventions; read repository and API contracts.
Keep server-side authorization checks and revision identity.
Add focused tests for search, pagination, and access errors; run required checks.

technicalNotes: Do not treat client-provided repository identifiers as authorization proof.
Do not implement Git write operations here.
